source.branch: compute/k4-dl13 (the n = 4 runs of compute/k4-dl13-n4, merged into it)

refutes.statement: Conjecture DL13 (k4/dl2.md §3): at f >= 1 every min-frozen P with def(P) > 0 has a min-frozen P' with def(P') < def(P) reached by (T1) a re-base keeping the needed set or (T3) a role swap with a needer and at most one helper giving up a good. Here f = 3 (one free agent) and every improvement moves frozen goods between frozen agents (an exchange of two frozen goods, or a chain ending at the free agent)

Conjecture DL_T (k4/dl2.md §3): the same with (T2) rotations of free agents allowed as well; none of the improvements keeps the key or is a role swap with at most one helper (this PR does not change the row's status; it belongs to proof/k4-dl2-k1)

repair.move: frozen agents 0 and 3 exchange their goods 4 and 5

notes: Found by the exhaustive run of k4/dl13.c over every strict profile of the n = 4 cores with one 4-good agent (compute/k4-dl13-n4, results/k4_dl13/n4_1.log: DL13 fails at 20 states, all on this core); confirmed by k4/dl13.c, k4/dl2_relations.py (model.py) and main's k4/c4x_check.py with k4/dl2_relations_xcheck.rel_B (attempts/k4_dl13_refuted.py). Agents 2 and 3 are twins. f = 3, omega = 1, 18 min-frozen P. P = ({4},{1},{3},{5}): agents 0, 2, 3 frozen (needs {5}, {3,5}, {4}, {3,4}; NA = {3,4,5}), the free agent 1 the only owner, its bundle {0,1,2} threatens agent 0 (2 + 3 > 4), so def(P) = 1. Exchanging the frozen goods of agents 0 and 3 gives each its top good and makes {0,1,2} safe: def 0. No min-frozen P' with a smaller deficit has P's key or arises by a role swap with at most one helper, so DL_T fails here too. Least m for this shape at n = 4 (f = 3 with omega >= 1 needs m >= 6); n <= 3 has no DL13 failure (results/k4_dl13/n3.log). Not in predicates.py: check with python3 k4/suite/run.py --pred=k4/dl13_pred.py:dl13_c (or :dl13_model, :dl13_x), which must give FAILS.
